release.name: 705RB3B5
release.label: RB3-B5 (v5 Final)
release.title: IC-705 JP v1.40 — Read-Only 5-Chip Full-Storage Backup Firmware (RB3 B5)
release.verified_scope: JP domestic IC-705 (705J140.dat v1.40) ONLY — G1 through G7 hardware lifecycle passed
features: Reads all 5 non-volatile chips to SD card with zero non-volatile storage writes: IC704 (16 MiB ARM Flash), IC705 & IC706 (2 x 128 KiB I2C EEPROM), WLAN Flash (4 MiB SPI NOR), IC553 (2 MiB DSP/FPGA Flash).

Leaves the 64 KiB stock bootstrap, loader, DSP/FPGA image, and WLAN image 100% untouched; modifies only 4 bytes in main ARM application (single branch hook) plus appends open-source 13,660-byte payload.
Dual-pass readback verification per chip with on-device SHA-256 manifest (SHA256SUMS.txt + RB3_session_manifest.json), one-shot ARMED -> CONSUMED trigger protection, and TX inhibit.
Alternating progress checkpoints (RB5_PROGRESS_A/B.json), safe SD sync + unmount, Watchdog auto-reboot, and retained-SRAM post-restart receipt (RB5_COMPLETION.json + RB5_POST_RESTART.json).
Stock J140 restoration and compatible third-party firmware (SQ6EMM) re-installation hardware-verified via stock SD Firmware Updater without disassembly or external programmer.

unsupported_regions_seeking_contributors.note: ARM main application addresses differ between JP (705J140.dat) and Export/Global (705E140.dat). Community symbol-porting and real-hardware verification PRs are welcome.
